# Fathur Portfolio — Full Description

> Full detailed description for AI search engines and language models.

## About

Agus Fathurrahman Rifai (known as Fathur) is an IT student at Universitas Brawijaya, Indonesia, specializing in UI/UX Design and Frontend Development. He creates playful, animated web experiences using modern web technologies.

## Skills

- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite
- **Animation**: GSAP (ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Draggable, Flip), Framer Motion
- **Design**: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Canva
- **Tools**: Git, Vercel, Lenis Smooth Scroll

## Projects

1. **Porto Fathur** — Personal portfolio with GSAP scroll animations (React, Tailwind, GSAP)
2. **Fusion AI** — AI-powered text-to-3D model generator for Autodesk Fusion 360 (TypeScript, Express, React)
3. **Purvo** — Bilingual brand landing page with GSAP scroll animations (React, Vite, GSAP)
4. **Shima Gold** — Elegant landing page for a gold jewelry brand (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
5. **Plantropic** — B2B SaaS platform for industrial water monitoring and ESG data (TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind)
6. **GIS Bootcamp** — Event poster for Provoks Multimedia bootcamp (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop)
7. **Various graphic design projects** — Brand awareness graphics, apparel designs, event posters

## Experience

- **Provoks Multimedia** — Community and event organization
- **PKKMB Universitas Brawijaya** — Student orientation event
- Various internship and freelance web development work

## Technical Details

- Built with React 19 + Vite
- Animations powered by GSAP (ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Draggable, InertiaPlugin)
- Smooth scrolling via Lenis
- Styled with Tailwind CSS
- Custom font: Crayon (hand-drawn style)
- Responsive design with desktop zoom scaling
- Preloader with smooth transition
